acceptance: PROVISIONAL; RMS pass with median and regional limitations; actual private browser raster verified
limitations: Seven excluded checks give RMS 81.30 m, median 81.28 m, P95 117.73 m and maximum 123.91 m. RMS passes 100 m, but the median exceeds the suggested 75 m companion bound.

Walter and Bickerton Islands and the small northern lake have separate control/check endpoints, so these observations are spatially correlated. Most islands have sparse local validation and are not independently accepted in full.

The changed Holland Head barrier, Tobacco Island northern connection, harbour interiors and minor shore features are retained without local acceptance. Rounded Cape St Marys, Cape Mocodome and Holland Island west-shore checks use 18 px working source uncertainty.
Land and checks occupy the northern coastal band. The broad southern ocean frame contains no independent physical check features; northern parcel interiors remain incompletely validated.
